attchmntText: Premier Limited has informed the Exchang that Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Please find enclosed copies of Newspaper Advertisements pertaining to the publication of Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30th September 2026, published in Financial Express, Pune Edition (English) and Loksatta, Pune Edition (Marathi) on 07 November 2026.
voiceSummary: Premier Limited submitted newspaper advertisements to the BSE and NSE regarding the publication of financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express Pune Edition and Loksatta Pune Edition on 07 November 2026. The company is currently under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. Kanak Jani is serving as the Resolution Professional. The document confirms the submission of these notices for regulatory record. No voting results or resolutions are mentioned in this filing. The submission is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.
